outcome: immunohistochemical expression of interferon-gamma (IFN-γ) in placentas
cohort: 30 placentas from women with preeclampsia (n=10), placenta previa (n=10), and normal pregnancies (n=10)
finding: The study found that IFN-γ expression was significantly increased in placentas from women with preeclampsia compared to those with placenta previa and normal pregnancies.
